John Cornyn and Attorney General Ken Paxton to a runoff, President Donald Trump said he would endorse one of them “soon” and expected the candidate he did not support to withdraw. The Texas Tribune reported the statement and noted Trump had remained neutral during the primary. State Rep. James Talarico won the Democratic nomination. This draft records only Trump’s public statement and the immediate election context. It does not claim that Trump had already endorsed Cornyn or Paxton, that either candidate withdrew, or that Trump’s statement changed the eventual result. The supplied New York Times URL is described as an analysis, but its body could not be independently verified during this review; it cannot establish the article’s full four-question framing. The Texas Tribune’s same-day reporting supports this narrower account. These facts document campaign pressure in an election contest, not unlawful state action or abuse of government power, so the existing Government Power Abuse classification needs a separate evidence-based review.
